'''Myssith''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] active on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]]. She was killed by a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] hired by a rival, her sister named [[Ysith]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Myssith appeared as a non-player character in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Star Wars video games#Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
